state: Session 4 opened 18.9.2026 with the plan agreed the night before: hook spike, P4, spec v3 (dock's Still decision and the recorder's removal deferred). The hook spike is done: hook-collector built (src-tauri/src/bin/hook.rs, installed as ~/.reviewglass/bin/reviewglass-hook.exe, configured as a PostToolUse hook in ~/.claude/settings.json) and PostToolUse measured to fire on BOTH surfaces (Desktop Code tab, entrypoint claude-desktop, 2.1.274; CLI print mode, entrypoint sdk-cli, 2.1.268). The hook is P4's primary trigger everywhere; the transcript's tool records are not needed; 6.1's 'CLI only' bracket around the hook was an assumption and moves in spec v3. The collector prunes events older than an hour, so the spool stays small until the app reads it. Session 3 (17.9.2026) opened from the four observations at the top of docs/CHANGELOG.md. Shipped: observations 2, 3 and 4 as one change. A freeze with no frame in hand lets one frame through before holding, so Still from the dock is no longer black; every ReviewGlass menu holds the engine and the rider while it is open, so the lens stays under its menu and a still taken from the menu is the frame that was right-clicked on; and the glass canvas is no longer wiped on every state change, the cause found under both the black still and the menu in the still. Verified on the release build over CDP and window rects (see the CHANGELOG for what was measured). Observation 1, Follow restless with the width changing: the measurement recorder shipped (Settings > Measurements, Record/Stop, one time-named file per recording under %TEMP%, structure only, temporary tooling), the owner's first recording named three causes, and all three were tuned as one change on the owner's call (capture/track.rs: the right edge is the furthest line of the last ten seconds, a lost column is held two seconds; Fit: a column wider than half the screen waits three seconds), replayed against the recording (50 changes to 23, 12 nones to 0, 9 resizes to 6, no leap to 2252 px). The owner's second recording (50 s Follow) shows reading calm: no resize in 36 s of reading, the right edge held exactly; what remained was the trip to the dock, so Follow now holds while the cursor is over the dock (as over the glass), which also gives the dock's Still a meaning: freeze what the glass showed before the cursor left for the dock (to confirm with the owner, then an ADR). Session 2 (13.9.2026): adr.rg.017 pane detection with lock, Fit and the viewfinder; adr.rg.018 the dock, the panel as its drawer, the RG mark as a one-click switch, the global shortcut said and settable; the glass and the panel start hidden. Session 1 (11.-12.9.2026): from spec to a tool the owner uses, P0 spike, P1 magnifier, P2 session panel, P3 alerts, sixteen ADRs, docs to the family standard. Session 3 closed late on 17.9.2026 with the dock hold merged; the shortcut's exe is rebuilt from main but its dock hold was not checked on screen (no more live runs that evening).

deploy.surface: the owner's own Windows 11 machine only; no hosted component
deploy.binary: src-tauri/target/release/reviewglass.exe of the main checkout, launched from Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts; the build agent pulls and rebuilds it after every merge and verifies on warm launches (the bar and the dock carry the build stamp)
deploy.collector: ~/.reviewglass/bin/reviewglass-statusline.exe (statusLine) and ~/.reviewglass/bin/reviewglass-hook.exe (PostToolUse, matcher Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit), both configured in ~/.claude/settings.json (backups: settings.json.bak-reviewglass-p0, -p4)
deploy.installers: NSIS and MSI both build; not yet used — P7
deploy.atlas: system reviewglass; status via atlas_put_status; MCP worker redeployed manually after each model merge (CI only dry-runs)

workflow: Code and docs in English, conversation in Finnish. cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + cargo test + pnpm check before every commit; CI on windows-latest runs the same. Commit straight to main while the repo is private and single-author; the Atlas model changes go through a PR on the Atlas repo, then wrangler deploy of the MCP worker. A new decision enters the Atlas model first and is rendered into docs/adr/ by node scripts/adr-from-model.mjs. End a session by updating docs/CHANGELOG.md, docs/BUILD_INFO.json and, if a lesson was learned, docs/LESSONS.md; put the status to Atlas.
next: P4 live diff, in order: (1) spool-watcher reads spool/events into ChangeEvent (tolerate half-written files, ignore events older than the app's start); (2) diff-service: git diff scoped to the path, debounce rapid edits to one file, 'untracked' outside a repo, the secret-file denylist (.env*, *.pem, *.key, id_*, *.tfvars); (3) the Diff tab renders DiffView (hunks, path, +/- counts) with an existing diff renderer, and names the reason when there is nothing (no edit yet / not a git repo / denylisted). Exit: an agent edit appears within ~1 s
